authorship_note: Project source was developed with AI assistance and includes adapted or inherited framework/runtime helpers. The inventory identifies submitted source; it does not assert that every included line was authored from scratch. Dependency notices remain in the repository.
exclusion_note: No foreign projects, dependency trees, build outputs, real .env files, untouched components/ui, vendored PDF.js worker, or temporary runtime state. Generated model/data/evaluation JSON, the dependency lockfile, supporting prose, and binary assets are hash-listed rather than printed. All printed files are also embedded in the PDF as byte-exact source attachments. Inclusion does not assert that inherited runtime helpers were authored from scratch.

pdf.line_number_convention: Original source line; > marks a wrapped continuation.
